def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    roll_idx = 0
    
    # Process frames 1-9
    for frame in range(9):
        if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike
            score += 10 + rolls[roll_idx + 1] + rolls[roll_idx + 2]
            roll_idx += 1
        elif rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1] == 10:  # Spare
            score += 10 + rolls[roll_idx + 2]
            roll_idx += 2
        else:  # Open frame
            score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
            roll_idx += 2
    
    # Process frame 10 (no bonus rolls)
    if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike in frame 10
        score += 10
    else:  # One or two rolls in frame 10
        score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
    
    return score

def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    roll_idx = 0
    
    # Process frames 1-9
    for frame in range(9):
        if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike
            score += 10
            # Add next two rolls if they exist
            if roll_idx + 1 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx + 1]
            if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
            roll_idx += 1
        elif rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1] == 10:  # Spare
            score += 10
            # Add next roll if it exists
            if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
            roll_idx += 2
        else:  # Open frame
            score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
            roll_idx += 2
    
    # Process frame 10 (no bonus rolls)
    if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike in frame 10
        score += 10
    else:  # One or two rolls in frame 10
        score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
    
    return score
